clusters.reason: All four manifestations use the same original SwiftUI RiverSensorTriageBoard.swift primary-button implementation and no-selection disabled path: the action label receives palette.disabled as its background inside Button, then PlainButtonStyle and .disabled(selected == nil) apply. The same source is used for P1/P2; only the theme palette and text scale differ. Own-D0 and common-D0 original native boxes and all cited screenshots show the same altered fill in baseline and replaced within each theme (#FFCFCDC5 for light instead of #FFAAA99F, #FF33474C for dark instead of #FF52666A). Approved ownership assigns the final solid primary face to the component. Repeated states and theme variants are manifestations of the shared disabled-action appearance path, not four independent bugs. The precise framework opacity/compositing internals remain inferred, but the shared source path, state trigger and rendered contradiction establish this cause membership. No Android or unconfirmed wrapping rows are included.
